highlights.title: Peaked in the playoffs
highlights.text: Chud (JM) won the actual championship despite finishing just 4th in the regular-season power rank with only 1 week as high scorer — the opposite of a wire-to-wire story.

highlights.title: Best record, no respect
highlights.text: The Masonic Temple had the league's best record at 11-3 — yet finished only 3rd in the power rank and never once posted the week's high score. Great at winning close ones, never truly dominant.

highlights.title: Says it all
highlights.text: I was top scorer week 1 was, in fact, top scorer exactly once — week 1. The name has aged with brutal accuracy ever since.

highlights.title: Consistently solid
highlights.text: Loose Ends led the league in both the regular-season power rank and the weekly high-scorer count (3 wins) — the most complete season of anyone who didn't end up hoisting the trophy.
